title: NexSight: Verifiable Tasks for Fine-Grained Agentic Long-Video Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2611.22790v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Fine-grained questions about long videos ask how many times an action occurs, in what order events unfold, or exactly when a state changes. Answering them can require finding brief moments scattered across hours of footage. Agentic models that decide when and where to look promise to find these moments, yet this ability is hard both to measure and to learn. Sparse supporting evidence may establish that an action occurred without establishing its total count; verifying timeline-wide claims requires checking for missed occurrences and double counting. Answer-only supervision, in turn, does not explicitly supervise the search for evidence. We present NexSight, which builds verifiable tasks to both evaluate and train agentic long-video understanding. Its agentic pipeline, SightForge, accepts a task only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct it from evidence densely reacquired from the raw video and counterexample checks f

translated_title: NexSight：用于细粒度智能体长视频理解的可验证任务
translated_abstract: 关于长视频的细粒度问题包括：某个动作发生了多少次、事件以什么顺序展开、或者某个状态确切在何时发生变化。回答这些问题可能需要在长达数小时的视频中寻找分散各处的短暂片段。能够自主决定何时、何地去观看的智能体模型有望找到这些时刻，但这一能力既难以衡量也难以学习。稀疏的支持证据可能仅能证明某个动作发生过，却无法确定其发生的总次数；而验证贯穿整个时间线的论断，则需要检查是否存在遗漏的 occurrence 和重复计数。此外，仅有答案的监督方式无法对证据搜索过程进行显式监督。我们提出 NexSight，通过构建可验证任务来同时评估和训练智能体长视频理解能力。其智能体流水线 SightForge 只有在如下条件下才接受一个任务：对草拟答案一无所知的验证者能够基于从原始视频密集重新获取的证据以及反例检查来重构该任务……
tldr: 提出NexSight框架，通过SightForge智能体流水线构建可验证的长视频任务——要求与答案隔离的验证者仅凭从原始视频密集重新获取的证据和反例检查即可重构任务——从而同时实现对细粒度智能体长视频理解的评估与训练。
en_tdlr: NexSight introduces verifiable tasks through the SightForge agentic pipeline, where tasks are accepted only if a verifier blind to the draft answer can reconstruct them from densely reacquired video evidence and counterexample checks, enabling both evaluation and training of fine-grained agentic long-video understanding.
